manifest.duration_policy: Sum of per-case fail-safe maxima may exceed the whole-trial cap. Admission reserves the next case maximum plus cleanup reserve against the original trial deadline. Any unadmitted case remains NOT_RUN, and an incomplete run cannot close the investigation.
manifest.sample_policy: All cases except installed-idle run round-robin by repetition; reverse the declared case order on alternate repetitions. The sole installed-idle sample runs last, after all other 65 samples, and closes further admission with explicitly qualified stopped-resource retention. Each sample is a fresh process. No p95. Root controls disable timing hooks while preserving correctness, body counters and resource monitoring.
